experiment: Twelve full-scale simply supported C- and Z-purlin/through-fastened roof-panel assemblies (two purlin lines at 5 ft spacing, 237.5 in. span, with intermediate lateral braces at mid-span or one-third span) were loaded to failure by uplift in a vacuum chamber, and the measured ultimate uniform loads were compared with Cornell University method, unstiffened-flange, modified Cornell, and 1986 AISI (Se Fy) predictions.
title: Uplift Tests of Braced C- and Z-Purlin/Roof Panel Assemblies (MBMA/MRI purlin test program)

variables.definition: Specimen number identifying each of the 12 purlin uplift tests as printed in the tables.
variables.evidence: Table 1 (pp. 4, 13), Table 2 (pp. 5, 15), Table 3 (p. 6), Table 3 (p. 21), Table S1
variables.name: Test number

variables.definition: Cross-section shape of the purlin in the specimen, C or Z, as listed in the test matrix.
variables.name: Purlin section type

variables.definition: Location along the span of the intermediate discrete lateral brace (mid-span or one-third span) used in each test.
variables.name: Intermediate brace location

variables.definition: Simple-span length of the purlins between supports, printed as 237.5 in. for every test.
variables.evidence: Table 1 (pp. 4, 13) column span_in; Table S1 column span_in_in; also used in Mt = w l^2/8 note
variables.name: Purlin span length
variables.note: span_ft column in Table S1 left empty; report states span only in inches

variables.definition: Position of the individual purlin within each two-purlin specimen: N = north, S = south.
variables.name: Purlin position in pair

variables.definition: Measured out-to-out depth H of the purlin cross-section (Figure 1 notation), reported per purlin and as north/south pair.
variables.evidence: Table 2 (pp. 5, 15) column h_in; Table S1 column depth_in
variables.name: Purlin depth
variables.note: Test 9 south printed as '9 7.063'; corrected to 9.063 in. in the dataset

variables.definition: Measured width of one flange of the purlin, dimension B1 in Figure 1.
variables.name: Flange width B1
variables.note: Test 3 north printed 3.938 in.; corrected to 2.938 in.

variables.definition: Measured width of the opposite flange of the purlin, dimension B2 in Figure 1.
variables.name: Flange width B2
variables.note: Printed as 'R2' on p.5 and 'B2' on p.15

variables.definition: Measured length of the edge stiffener (lip) L1 on the B1 flange, Figure 1 notation.
variables.name: Lip length L1

variables.definition: Measured length of the edge stiffener (lip) L2 on the opposite flange, Figure 1 notation.
variables.name: Lip length L2
variables.note: Test 5 south printed 8.813 in.; corrected to 0.813 in.

variables.definition: Measured inside corner radius r1 of the purlin cross-section (Figure 1).
variables.name: Corner radius r1

variables.definition: Measured inside corner radius r2 of the purlin cross-section (Figure 1).
variables.name: Corner radius r2

variables.definition: Measured base steel thickness of each purlin, reported per purlin and as north/south pair.
variables.evidence: Table 2 (pp. 5, 15) column t_in; Table S1 column thickness_in
variables.name: Base steel thickness

variables.definition: Measured angle of the edge stiffener (lip) from the flange, Figure 1 notation.
variables.evidence: Table 2 (pp. 5, 15) column phi_deg; Table S1 column lip_angle_deg
variables.name: Lip (edge stiffener) angle

variables.definition: Measured yield stress of the purlin steel from coupon tests, reported per purlin and as north/south pair.
variables.evidence: Table 2 (pp. 5, 15) column fy_ksi; Table S1 column fy_ksi
variables.name: Yield stress

variables.definition: Measured initial sweep (lateral out-of-straightness) of each purlin; negative values indicate sweep toward the south.
variables.name: Initial purlin sweep

variables.definition: Maximum uniform uplift line load carried at failure, computed from the vacuum-chamber transducer pressure as P (lb/ft) = reading (psf) x (76 in./2)/12.
variables.evidence: Table 3 (p. 21) column pu_lb_ft; Table S1 column failure_load_as_printed
variables.name: Tested failure load
variables.note: Pressure only; no self-weight term included

variables.definition: Unit in which the failure load is printed (lb/ft) recorded alongside the summary value.
variables.name: Failure load unit

variables.definition: Failure load computed by the Cornell University method (Ref. 1) for each specimen.
variables.name: Cornell method predicted load

variables.definition: Failure load computed treating the purlin as having an unstiffened compression flange.
variables.name: Unstiffened-flange predicted load

variables.definition: Failure load computed by the modified Cornell University method.
variables.name: Modified Cornell predicted load
variables.note: Dashes for tests where not evaluated

variables.definition: Ratio of measured failure load to the Cornell University method predicted load.
variables.evidence: Table 3 (p. 21) column pu_over_pc; Table S1 column pu_over_pc
variables.name: Pu/Pc ratio

variables.definition: Ratio of measured failure load to the unstiffened-flange computed failure load.
variables.evidence: Table 3 (p. 21) column pu_over_pc_prime; Table S1 column pu_over_pc_prime
variables.name: Pu/Pc' ratio

variables.definition: Ratio of measured failure load to the modified Cornell method computed failure load; mean 1.026 and standard deviation 0.1010 reported for tests 5-12.
variables.evidence: Table 3 (p. 21) column pu_over_pc_dprime plus Mean/Std rows; Table S1 column pu_over_pc_double_prime
variables.name: Pu/Pc" ratio
variables.note: Mean and standard deviation rows apply only to this column

variables.definition: Ratio of the test moment Mt = w l^2/8 to the nominal moment Mn = Se Fy computed per the 1986 AISI Specification Section C3.1.1.
variables.evidence: Table 3 (p. 6) column mt_over_mn; Table S1 column mt_over_mn
variables.name: Mt/Mn ratio

variables.definition: Direction of the applied load, uplift generated by the vacuum chamber, for all tests.
variables.name: Load direction

variables.definition: Number of spans in each test specimen (1, simply supported single span).
variables.name: Number of spans

variables.definition: Number of parallel purlin lines in each test specimen (2).
variables.name: Number of purlin lines

variables.definition: Type of roof panel and its attachment to the purlin tension flange (through-fastened 24 ga. panel with self-drilling screws at 12 in. on center).
variables.evidence: Table S1 column panel_type and header note
variables.name: Roof panel / attachment type

variables.definition: Purlin spacing within the specimen, stated as 5 ft for all tests in the header notes.
variables.evidence: Header note of Table 1 and Table S1: 'Purlins were spaced 5 ft apart'
variables.name: Purlin spacing
variables.note: Stated in a header note, not a column

variables.definition: Observed limiting mode of the test, e.g. local buckling of the edge stiffener at about 94 lb/ft followed by beam action with an unstiffened compression flange.
variables.name: Observed failure mode

variables.definition: Approximate load at which local buckling of the edge stiffener was first observed in tests 1-4, stated as about 94 lb/ft in the header note.
variables.evidence: Table S1 header note: 'buckled the edge stiffener locally at about 94 lb/ft'
variables.name: Edge stiffener buckling load
variables.note: Given in a note, not as a column

variables.definition: Provenance fields recording the table and PDF page(s) from which each summary value was taken.
variables.evidence: Table S1 columns value_source and pages
variables.name: Value source and page

variables.definition: Failure moment placeholder columns in the summary table; the report does not print failure moments so the fields are empty.
variables.evidence: Table S1 columns failure_moment_as_printed and failure_moment_unit
variables.name: Failure moment (not reported)
variables.note: Columns are empty; moment only available through Mt/Mn
